title: 30A Beach House Whatcha Dune Panhandle Getaways
meta_description: 30A Beach House rental, Whatcha Dune, located in Inlet Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Free Activities Included. see details below***
description_expanded: Description Description 30A Beach House rental, Whatcha Dune, located in Inlet Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES* 30A Beach House - Inlet Beach* Golf Cart Included* Large Living Area - Smart TV* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* Dining Area * Bedroom 1 - King Bed , Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 2 - King Bed, Smart TV* Bathroom 2 - Full Bathroom with Shower* Bedroom 3 - Queen Bed, Smart TV* Bathroom 3 - Tub/Shower Combo* Bedroom 4 - Full Bed, Bunk Bed (T/T/T)* Washer/Dryer* Fire Pit with Seating* Grill* Beach Chairs* Pack and Play, High Chair, and Baby Gates * Parking* Complimentary High Speed WI-FI* Sleeps 11 Surveillance Device - This home has outdoor security cameras. *Note: The owner's beach chairs and baby gear are included with your stay. However, if any item becomes lost or broken and is unavailable for use, no refund will be issued, as these items are provided as a courtesy by the owner. 30A Beach Access Points ABOUT INLET HEIGHTSInlet Heights is a highly desirable neighborhood within Grande Pointe in Inlet Beach, FL, located just east of Rosemary Beach. Just 0.3 miles from the Gulf, this coastal community offers a community pool, a private dock on Lake Powell, and a community pavilion. Residents enjoy convenient access to Inlet Beach public beach accesses, shopping and dining at 30Avenue, Scenic Highway 30A, and outdoor recreation such as kayaking, fishing, and hiking at nearby Camp Helen State Park. COMMUNITY AMENITIESCommunity PoolDock on Lake PowellPavilionPublic Beach AccessEasy Access to Shopping and DiningFamily Friendly Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar and body wash. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read more
